en: I see. I guess baseball and soccer players don't really take their clothes off. And even though they're built, they don't show a lotta muscle.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Exactly. And muscle is what I want to see. Also, wearing a tank top all the time is a really big plus for me!<Color:Default>
Heh, perv. You think like a dirty old man.
<Color:255,200,200,255>And what's wrong with that? You guys watch porn videos and stuff, right?<Color:Default>
Right. I see yer point.
I don't.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Well, you're too old for that kind of stuff.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hey, wait. Just how old do guys get before they stop watching porn? Do guys stop after they get a girlfriend or get married?<Color:Default>
Just when we're single. If ya got a girl, ya don't need 'em.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Huh. I expected as much.<Color:Default>
<Color:Default>So does that mean you have a girlfriend, Saejima-san?<Color:255,200,200,255>
Nah, that ain't it.
We watch more after marriage.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Wait, what? Why? Aren't you satisfied with being able to see your wife naked?<Color:Default>
What do ya mean, why? We're guys. That's how we're wired.
<Color:255,200,200,255>What's that supposed to mean? No way!<Color:Default>
Until the day we die. Man has three basic desires: sleep, food, and sex. If one of those is missin', might as well be dead.
<Color:255,200,200,255>That makes sense! In that case, I'll go on being a muscle-lover until the day I die!<Color:Default>
Heh, yeah.
How about sumo?
<Color:255,200,200,255>I can't stand that at all! Sumo wrestlers are just full of fat! Muscles are what I'm after! Muscles!<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>I've never seen a match, actually. I thought about going to see it once, but I was too scared to go by myself.<Color:Default>
Wanna go with me? Then ya wouldn't be scared.
<Color:255,200,200,255>You really mean it!?<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh, but I hear it's pretty tough to get your hands on tickets to a martial arts event.<Color:Default>
That's okay. I used to help out at a gym, and I still got some connections.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Wow, really? That's so cool, Saejima-san!<Color:Default>
It's more fun on TV. If ya go to the arena, everyone just looks like little specks.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh, I guess that makes sense. On TV they show celebrities sitting ringside, but I guess most regular people don't get to do that.<Color:Default>
Not without the right connections, nope.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Guess I'll have to be content with television.<Color:Default>
Why not join up? Then ya'd get to see things real up close and personal.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Huh? What do you mean?<Color:Default>
You know, one of them ring girls. Then ya'd get to be right by the fighters.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh, I guess that would work!<Color:Default>
And ya look the part, too.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I wonder how someone becomes a ring girl. I'll have to look into it!<Color:Default>
Ya really wanna see muscles that bad?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Do you want to get married, Saejima-san?<Color:Default>
Do I look like that kinda guy to you?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hmmm... I guess?<Color:Default>
I see. I suppose if I'd had a wife, my life wouldn't have ended up this way.
<Color:255,200,200,255>It's still not too late! Why not start looking for a bride now?<Color:Default>
I'll think about it.
No way. I'm not the marryin' type.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Really? Are you just playing tough?<Color:Default>
...Maybe a bit.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I thought you must be lonely! Oh, you're adorable, Saejima-san!<Color:Default>
Nah, it's true.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh come now. Really?<Color:Default>
How about you?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Don't try to dodge the subject! Tell me for real now. Are you?<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>It's not like I want to get married or even raise children, but...<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Recently, I thought it would be good to have someone to take care of me.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Well, then I wouldn't need to work for a living. That'd be a pretty nice way to live, no?<Color:Default>
That sure sounds like ya. Well, marriage has its pros and cons. I suppose yer way of thinkin' ain't that bad.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah, see? Marriage isn't as simple as loving someone. It needs more than that to last.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>If I did get married, I'd marry a rich guy!<Color:Default>
Yeah, but a rich guy's gotta choose you, too.
Get real. How many women do ya think actually get to live a life like that?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Ugh, can't a girl dream!? Girls aspire to get married one day.<Color:Default>
Girls who think that way wind up losin' out on other opportunities just to get hitched. Compromise is the key to any marriage.
<Color:255,200,200,255>If marriage takes compromise, then I'm happy to live the free life of a single woman!<Color:Default>
Ya really hate doin' work that much?
At least do housework. If yer husband's gonna work, you should do somethin' too.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Well, then I'll just hire a housekeeper or something.<Color:Default>
But what would he get outta that?
<Color:255,200,200,255>So my friend from high school is getting a divorce because she got caught cheating by her husband.<Color:Default>
She was the one cheatin'?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah. If he had cheated, I could have been there to share her anger or cheer her up. But since she's at fault, I don't know what to do.<Color:Default>
Chew her out. Ya can't trust a backstabber. Otherwise, what's to stop her from stabbin' you in the back someday?
<Color:255,200,200,255>I don't know. I don't think she's that bad a person.<Color:Default>
I see. Well, if ya say so. Everyone makes mistakes.
<Color:255,200,200,255>You have a very open mind, Saejima-san.<Color:Default>
Just stay on yer guard. Once someone does somethin' like that, their morals fall by the wayside.
They'll cross lines most folks would never cross with surprisin' ease. I saw a ton of people like that in prison.
<Color:255,200,200,255>In prison!? I don't know if it's fair to compare cheating to something like that.<Color:Default>
Don't say anythin'. If she's really yer friend, ya gotta stay by her side and believe in her.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I suppose so. Besides, she'll be single like me now. I should ask her out to dinner.<Color:Default>
Good idea. Havin' a friend to break bread with is more comfortin' than the food itself.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I bet you have friends like that too!<Color:Default>
Ya gotta grow up still. Bein' a divorcee and bein' single ain't the same.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh, mind your own business. Speaking of which, why don't you get married yourself?<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Actually, I'm friends with her husband too, so our relationship is going to be tough from now on.<Color:Default>
Yer stuck between a rock and a hard place.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Don't I know it. Should I try to make the husband feel better?<Color:Default>
Sure. Bein' stabbed in the back is rough. He's probably a mess right now.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Have you been cheated on before, Saejima-san?<Color:Default>
It ain't exactly a tale of romance, but I've been betrayed by someone I thought was a friend.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I'm guessing you were mad?<Color:Default>
At myself. I was an idiot for trustin' him. But in the end it was all a big misunderstandin'.
<Color:255,200,200,255>So then did you patch things up?<Color:Default>
Yeah. All it took was one good, hard punch.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I see! I envy how men can settle things!<Color:Default>
Don't do that. Ya oughta back off.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Aww. Why not?<Color:Default>
Men are different. They can't change how they feel with the flick of a switch like women.
Pickin' at a scab is only gonna make a wound worse, y'know? Right now he just needs time to heal on his own.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Ahh. Is that how it goes?<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Okay, I guess I won't get in touch with him.<Color:Default>
Yeah, that's for the best.
<Color:255,200,200,255>The other day a friend of mine told me they were in love with me, just out of nowhere.<Color:Default>
Well, ain't you popular with the boys?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Well... the friend in question is a woman.<Color:Default>
Oh. So then this is a lesbian thing?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah, I had no idea. I was pretty surprised.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>She's into women.<Color:Default>
Well, what did ya tell her?
<Color:255,200,200,255>I'm, uh, still mulling that over.<Color:Default>
What, you told her ya'd get back to her?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Come on! I'd hate to say something stupid and hurt her feelings. And besides...<Color:Default>
Besides what?
<Color:255,200,200,255>I've gotten to thinking, hey, maybe getting together with a girl would be pretty nice.<Color:Default>
Why's that? I mean, ya don't even feel that way about women, right?
<Color:255,200,200,255>That's not really the point. I've simply been thinking that having a wife would make my life a lot easier.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Like she could cook, clean, do my laundry⑬all sorts of things like that!<Color:Default>
Sounds nice. I wish I had a wife, too.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Right? Girls typically wind up with chores like that when they get married to a guy. So, if you get together with a girl, you won't have to!<Color:Default>
So yer gonna say yes to her?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Well... I guess whether it's a guy or a girl, dating someone is a big hassle in general. Staying single would be way less stressful.<Color:Default>
Yeah. Sharin' a room was nice 'cause I had someone to talk to, but bein' in solitary was much easier.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Huh? Solitary?<Color:Default>
Uh, never mind, just talkin' to myself...
Men have their benefits, too. Cookin' and laundry is one thing, but not all women can handle physical labor.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah, that's true. On the flip side, I can't think of a reason I'd want to be with a woman instead of a man.<Color:Default>
Women might be better at raisin' kids, but if yer just gonna live with someone, shouldn't it be a guy?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hmm. I should think about this some more.<Color:Default>
But do ya even have feelings for this friend?
But yer not even...
<Color:255,200,200,255>I know, I just think it'd be more fun to have a friend around than be alone forever.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Haven't you ever felt that way, Saejima-san?<Color:Default>
I have. It's more fun to have a close friend around than to be alone.
<Color:255,200,200,255>See? Assuming you weren't planning on getting married, why don't you just live with a friend?<Color:Default>
Maybe. Havin' a friend around might make work stuff easier to deal with.
<Color:255,200,200,255>See? That's why I'm so conflicted over this.<Color:Default>
Hm. Never really thought about it...
Nope. I don't want anyone else buttin' in on my personal time.
<Color:255,200,200,255>What if someone said they'd take care of you, and pay for everything?<Color:Default>
Not a chance. A man handles his own problems. I'm not the sort to rely on others to take care of me.
<Color:255,200,200,255>You're a real tough guy, Saejima-san. If I could leech off of someone, I totally would.<Color:Default>
And is that what this friend offered ya? To do everything for you? How lazy can ya possibly be?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hehehe...<Color:Default>
It's better bein' alone. Addin' to yer family carelessly only brings more responsibility.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah, I guess a guy would see it that way. I don't want any responsibilities in my life.<Color:Default>
Then don't hook up with this girl. Two people livin' together creates responsibilities. And there'll always be arguments.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Right... I'll think about it a bit more.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hey, Saejima-san?<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Be honest. What do you think of me?<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Really? What do you like about me?<Color:Default>
Hm. Yer not two-faced. Cabaret clubs are usually places where men and women tell pretty little lies to each other. But yer always up front.
